text:
Jordan: Hey — I signed up earlier, verified my email, passed the payment 3DS flow with a GPay virtual card, but the onboarding credit never arrived.
emma_support: Sorry about that — can you share the account ID or email you used and the PM type? I can check logs quickly.
Jordan: email: jordan+trial@forwarded.example (it's an alias that forwards). PM: GPay VCN (virtual card). 3DS showed success. Region showed IE in the dashboard even though I'm in UK.
emma_support: Thanks. Two quick checks: 1) did you use an SSO or alias that forwards? 2) any unusual billing country on the card (bin country)? Those can trigger manual review/business gate.
Jordan: yes it's an alias that forwards to my gmail. PM bin shows US in the payment payload but dashboard region = IE (IP geolocate). weird.
payments-bot: autogrant-check result for acct=jordan-001: {reason: "blocked", checks: ["email_forwarding_detected", "pm_bin_country_mismatch"]}
maria_payments: confirmed — autogrant kicked out because of forwarded-alias + bin-country mismatch. I'll run a manual grant. @emma_support can you capture the signup trace_id for audit? I'll attach the ticket.
emma_support: trace_id 8f3c2a9b in signup logs — attaching to ticket PAY-3241. maria, instructions for manual grant?
maria_payments: doing manual grant now. Internal admin command we use:

```
# admin grant (internal only)
POST https://internal.redwood.io/admin/accounts/jordan-001/credits
Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Body: {"amount_cents":1000, "reason":"manual_onboard_grant","note":"email-forwarding + VCN bin mismatch"}
```

Will post when done.
chris_eng: I'll add a test to ensure VCN+forwarded-email shows up in logs with clearer flags; unexpected region redirect routing can cause confusion for support.
maria_payments: done — credits granted (1000 cents). Jordan, please confirm balance; I also attached PAY-3241 and flagged for payments_rule_tweak.
Jordan: I see the 1,000 cent credit now. Thanks 🙏. Appreciate the quick manual fix.
emma_support: Closing loop — escalated to payments for rule update and to infra for region-detection noise. Apologies for the friction. If anything else pops up ping this thread :thumbsup:
